reviews.body: Overall makes sense, thank you. One small comment

review_comments.body: No reason for these both to be Arc'd independently, now. We can create a `LazyRefInner` that holds both fields without an `Arc` and `LazyRef` just becomes an alias for an `Arc` of that.

comments.body:
done in 3bf96e1. `LazyRefInner<T>` now holds the `OnceLock` and the `create_queued` flag directly, and `LazyRef<T>` is an alias for `Arc<LazyRefInner<T>>`, so there is one `Arc` instead of two. Constructor is `LazyRefInner::hole()`.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
@pcbeingused333 The changelog entry just needs to move to the unreleased section now after the rebase
